admin.subtitle: Logo, home page texts, contact details, Google Map and social links for your public website.
admin.disabled_notice: The public website is switched off. Visitors to the home page are sent to the login page.
admin.editing_language_hint: Each language keeps its own text. Leave a field empty to show the built-in default text for that language.
admin.logo_hint: Shown in the app header, on invoices and on the website.
admin.logo_file_hint: PNG, JPG, WEBP or SVG, up to 2 MB. A wide logo on a transparent background looks best.
admin.favicon_hint: Square PNG, SVG or ICO, up to 512 KB.
admin.site_status_hint: Turn the public pages on or off.
admin.enabled_hint: When off, the home page sends visitors to the staff login.
admin.hero_image_hint: Wide photo of your shop or products, at least 1200 × 900 px, up to 4 MB.
admin.about_hint: A short story about your business.
admin.contact_details_hint: Shown in the footer, on the contact page and as call / WhatsApp buttons.
admin.notify_email_hint: New contact messages are emailed here (needs Email SMTP settings). Leave empty to use the contact email.
admin.map_hint: Shows your location on the home and contact pages.
admin.map_placeholder: Paste the Google Maps embed code, a google.com/maps link, an address or coordinates (23.7808, 90.2792)
admin.map_step1: Open Google Maps and find your shop.
admin.map_step2: Click Share → Embed a map → Copy HTML.
admin.map_step3: Paste it above and save. An address or coordinates also work.
admin.map_preview_hint: Preview of the saved map. Save again after changing it.
admin.social_hint: Full links to your pages. Empty ones are hidden.
admin.seo_hint: Short description shown by Google under your website name.
admin.sections_hint: Choose which sections appear on the website.
admin.faqs_subtitle: Questions and answers shown on the website FAQ page and home page.
